curated-gf-libertinus-serif-display-gf-l: Lekton is monospace and untapered, a tidy counterweight to Libertinus Serif Display, whose broad-nib downstrokes are fat and upstrokes threadlike. Lekton marches in fixed-width steps, made for quick glances rather than pages of reading.
curated-gf-libertinus-serif-display-gf-m: Hairline connectors thin as lightbulb wire hang off the chunky stems of Libertinus Serif Display, tight and loud. Maname, a classic serif with swelling curves, isn't meant for long paragraphs, though a boot maker's card would do.
curated-gf-libertinus-serif-display-news: Expressive Libertinus Serif Display sets sharp bright edges against fat darkness. Newsreader, a classic serif with mild swelling and open jaws, holds up for a few brief lines, like a workshop announcement.
curated-gf-libre-barcode-128-gf-biorhyme: Packed, shut-tight letters, good for a tear-off tab flyer. Libre Barcode 128 stays closed while BioRhyme, a text serif with brush-lifted curve ends and widely spaced capitals, opens everything up beneath it.
curated-gf-libre-barcode-128-text-gf-lai: Laila is an open text serif, say for a national park poster. Libre Barcode 128 Text keeps its counters nearly sealed and snug against neighbors, so Laila's open curves give a few lines room to breathe.
curated-gf-libre-barcode-128-text-gf-sha: Nearly sealed counters crowd Libre Barcode 128 Text (think a record label logo). Share Tech Mono, a monospace cut from one gauge of tubing, lays typewriter-like even-width letters beside it for quick, precise bursts of reading.
curated-gf-libre-barcode-128-text-gf-tuf: Tuffy reads like a pencil sketch drawn with steady pressure, its s parted widely, under Libre Barcode 128 Text. Tuffy, a sans-serif, welcomes quick glances more than endless paragraphs of text.
curated-gf-libre-barcode-39-extended-tex: Podkova, a text serif with a broad, welcoming c, sits under Libre Barcode 39 Extended Text (pecha kucha slides, say). Podkova stays friendly over pages, though small helpings suit it best.
curated-gf-libre-barcode-39-gf-almendra-: A squinting e gives Libre Barcode 39 its guarded look. Almendra SC, a text serif whose c, e and a stay open, sounds dignified but is made for brief stretches rather than paragraphs.
curated-gf-libre-barcode-39-gf-cousine: Structured Cousine is monospace, its curves sweeping open instead of curling shut. Libre Barcode 39 squints in closed letters while Cousine stands taller and looser, a technical hum easy in brief sittings.
